plan.title: Optional RFQ Terms Do Not Block Vendor Bid

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Provide the required event title so the event can be published.
Create the required Technical and RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the line item the vendor will quote.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA vendor to both stages.
Publish the configured eRFX event.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Move to the invited vendor portal session.
Open the Technical stage in the vendor portal.
Verify the RFQ-only clause is not shown on the Technical stage.
Verify the second RFQ-only clause is not shown on the Technical stage.
Open the RFQ pricing stage in the vendor portal.
Verify the first optional clause is shown on the RFQ stage.
Verify the second optional clause is shown on the RFQ stage.
Return to the buyer console to submit the vendor bid through the supported combined two-stage bidding flow.
Submit the invited vendor's technical response and RFQ quote at 100.
Confirm the vendor portal accepted the submission, demonstrating optional clauses did not block it.
Verify the buyer sees the vendor's RFQ response.
